## Highlights

- New: request a playlist with **increasing, decreasing or steady sonic energy**, enforced against real audio-feature data instead of being left entirely to the AI (e.g. "rock playlist with increasing energy from the 1990s to now"). Supported in English, Italian, French, Spanish and German.
- Track cards now let you favorite the **artist** separately from the **track**, with the heart icon showing which one applies.

## New and improved

- Per-artist quotas ("include 6 songs by X and 2 by Y") now parse correctly across all five supported languages, including natural phrasing that drops the repeated word in the second clause ("...and 2 by Y" instead of "...and 2 songs by Y").
- A requested minimum count for an artist ("at least 4 songs by X") is now explicitly treated as a floor, reducing the risk of the AI padding the playlist with that artist well past what was asked.
- Top-of rankings now paginate 10 at a time instead of expanding the full list at once.
- Generation stage timings in Statistics are sorted by descending average, surfacing the slowest stage first.
- Application logs are now visible in the container's live output (`docker logs`), not only in the on-disk log file.

## Fixes

- A request combining a decade with "to now" (e.g. "from the 1960s to now") is no longer silently narrowed to just that decade.
- Generated playlist titles and descriptions no longer state a track count that can drift from the actual number of tracks.
- AI-assigned period tags now use a consistent decade format.

## Upgrade notes

- No action required. Existing settings, favorites and playlist data carry over automatically.
